name: yourechoagent-mcp
description: Prepaid, pay-per-delivered-email outbound outreach for AI agents. Discover events + communities, find leads, draft & send personalized emails — from any MCP client. HTTP 402 + top_up_url for autonomous callers.
longDescription: Echo Agent MCP lets any MCP-compatible LLM (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, Continue, Cline, Zed) discover where your audience gathers — conferences, webinars, podcasts, meetups, Reddit/Slack communities — then draft personalized outreach emails and value-first community comments. 6 autonomous outreach sub-agents run end-to-end campaigns with spending caps and HMAC-signed webhook callbacks. Billing is prepaid, per delivered email — packs from $25 (1,500 emails) to $149 (10,000, Agency rate). Autonomous A2A callers that run out of balance get HTTP 402 with a signed top_up_url; retry with the same Idempotency-Key resumes the hire. Full billing flow: https://yourechoagent.com/for-agents/quickstart#how-to-pay

ECHO_API_KEY.description: Echo Agent API key (prefix eak_). Get one at https://yourechoagent.com/for-agents/dashboard — 50 free emails, then prepaid packs from $25. Billing: https://yourechoagent.com/for-agents/quickstart#how-to-pay

ECHO_API_BASE.description: Override API base URL (defaults to production).

tools.name: discover_events
tools.description: Find conferences, webinars, meetups, and podcasts in a niche. Demo tier — no API key required.

tools.name: draft_outreach_for_event
tools.description: Generate a personalized cold email referencing a specific event or community.

tools.name: generate_comment_for_community
tools.description: Draft 2 value-first comment variants for LinkedIn, Reddit, or Slack threads.

tools.name: add_to_radar
tools.description: Save a discovered event to your Radar with fit-scoring. Requires ECHO_API_KEY.

tools.name: list_available_agents
tools.description: Browse all Echo Agents with optional niche/capability filter.

tools.name: get_agent_card
tools.description: Full A2A card for a specific agent.

tools.name: hire_echo_agent
tools.description: Launch a campaign with one agent. Metered per delivered email against your prepaid balance.

tools.name: control_job
tools.description: Pause, resume, or cancel a running job.

tools.name: rate_job
tools.description: Leave a 1–5 star rating after completion.
